module "P_Dispatch.dsp"

product 0 PassPipeline "P_Dispatch"
  pipeline order=0 injection=BeforePostProcess views=Game|Editor requires=- enabled=-
  buffer "Big" RGBA16F resolution=Render scale=1 (inferred) clear=(0, 0, 0, 0) mips=1
  buffer "Small" RGBA16F resolution=Render scale=0.5 (inferred) clear=(0, 0, 0, 0) mips=1
  pass "Fill" compute injection=BeforePostProcess
    shader "/Project/Passes/Fill.usf" virtual="/Project/Passes/Fill.usf" entry=FillCS
    threads=(4, 4, 4) dispatch=(64, 32, 2)
    write Result = Big
  pass "Halved" compute injection=BeforePostProcess
    shader "Down.usf" virtual="" entry=DownCS
    threads=(8, 8, 1) (from the shader) dispatch=Big * 0.5
    read Source = Big
    write Result = Small
  pass "Scaled" compute injection=BeforePostProcess
    shader "Down.usf" virtual="" entry=UpCS
    threads=(16, 4, 1) dispatch=Small * 0.25
    read Source = Small
    write Result = Big
